visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female pianist with long brown hair tied in a ponytail, wearing a white blazer over a beige top, sits at a brown grand piano. She looks down at the keys with a focused, serene expression as she begins to play. The setting is a clean, white-walled studio with soft, even lighting that highlights the glossy texture of the piano. (2) The camera alternates between a medium shot of her profile and close-up shots of her hands moving gracefully across the ivory keys. Occasionally, semi-transparent overlays of her hands are layered over the main shot, creating a dreamlike, multifaceted visual effect of the performance. (3) The pianist continues her performance with gentle body swaying and rhythmic head movements that match the tempo of the music. Subtitles and song titles appear in elegant, minimalist typography in the center or bottom of the frame, changing as she transitions between musical segments. (4) The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout, emphasizing the professional and polished aesthetic of the studio environment. The video maintains a steady visual rhythm, with cuts occurring every few bars of music to provide different perspectives of the pianist and the instrument.
